title: How to report F&O income in ITR for AY 2026-27: Deadline, turnover, audit rules and key changes in tax forms

title: How capital gains on foreign shares are computed and taxed in India
summary: Upon returning to India, the person must compute capital gains from US shares in INR, using the exchange rate from the sale date. No concessions for rupee depreciation apply. Long-term gains are taxed at 12.5%, and disclosure of foreign assets is required for tax purposes.
